text:
anya.p (partnerships): FYI vendor wants a short-run joint embargo + marketplace handoff for H100/H200/B200 and a single ops playbook covering cross-GPU fallbacks. They proposed an embargo window around the first half of June (vendor prefers June 8-12). Can we confirm feasibility and what we need to commit?

mike.o (eng-ops): Couple quick notes:
- H100 is stable on our dedicated clusters; H200 acceptance tests still show occasional driver panics on 535.22 on a small subset of SKUs.
- Marketplace adds node churn and cold-start variability. We'll need warm pools and a preflight dry-run (ideally 48h before embargo).

chris.t (product): From product: we should avoid a single monolithic rollout. Proposal:
- Staggered lines: H100 -> H200 -> B200 over 72h, with each device getting a 24h canary.
- Rollback policy: immediate rollback on p99 latency spike > 200ms or error rate > 1.5% sustained over 5m.
- Naming: release artifacts must include device tags and model suffixes (e.g., `redwood/h100-prod:2026-06-01`).

sophia.mkt (marketing): Marketing needs two things from partners: embargo confirmation (exact dates) and an asset drop schedule. For coordinated press we need 10 business days heads-up for partner quote + 5 days for creative.

nate.s (solutions): SI checklist initial draft (high level):
- Required driver: >=535.30 for H200, >=535.10 for H100 (confirm vendor-provided minimums)
- Firmware: GPU microcode >= 3.2.1
- Kernel: 5.15+ recommended for certain device drivers
- Quant builds: int8/int4 build matrix + sample eval corpus
- Validation: perf-profile, cold-start latency tests, long-tail request variance
I'll put this into a doc and tag the SI leads.

mike.o (eng-ops): Ops gating checklist (draft):
1) Fleet: warm-pool size >= 15% of projected early traffic
2) Images: tagged and scanned (`redwood/h200:vX.Y.Z`)
3) Healthchecks: /metrics p95/p99, kernel oops watch
4) Smoke test command (marketplace nodes):
```
k8s run --image=redwood/hw-smoke --replicas=12 --labels=marketplace-smoke
```
5) Canary autoscaler policy: limit rps growth to +30% per 10m during canary
6) Fallback routes: gaudi-lite and h100-softcap models preloaded

nanya.p (partnerships): Vendor asked for an initial 30-day SLA window: 99.8% availability and 2hr incident response onboarding with vendor SRE. Ops/product: realistic?

chris.t (product): 99.8% for marketplace endpoints is tight but doable with warm pools and automated fallback. Cost estimate: warm pool + monitoring ~ +15-20% infra for first month. Need to define what "availability" counts (per-region vs global). Also require a readout dashboard and a joint postmortem clause in the partner agreement.

sophia.mkt (marketing): I'll propose two announcement windows to vendor: June 8 (tight) and June 22 (safer). If we go June 8 we need final assets by May 27. Also want a single canonical quote owner for each side.

mike.o (eng-ops): Draft failover runbook snippet to include in playbook:
```
1) Detect: alert if p99 > 180ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows
2) Start graceful drain: `r-infer --drain --pct 30 --window 5m`
3) Trigger fallback: `r-infer --fallback-model gaudi-lite --route 30%`
4) Scale warm pool: `infra scale --pool marketplace-warm --add 10`
5) Notify vendor SRE and oncall paging
```
I'll own the ops playbook PR: `ops/playbooks/marketplace-gpu-joint-embargo.md` and add telemetry dashboard links.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled marketplace integration dry run: `gpu-embargo-dryrun-4487658000` on 2026-05-20T02:00:00Z. Please confirm smoke test artifacts before that run.

nanya.p (partnerships): Action items:
- nate: SI checklist doc with driver/firmware floors by EOD Thu
- mike: ops playbook PR + runbook by Mon
- chris: finalize rollout/rollback policy and cost impact by Tue
- sophia: confirm embargo window and partner PR contact by Fri
- partnerships: coordinate final partner legal point for the 30-day SLA language
Any blockers?

chris.t (product): Add telemetry requirement: make latency/error dashboards viewable to partner read-only for the first 30 days. Also include model-quality smoke tests (top-k token drift, hallucination heuristics) as entry criteria.

nate.s (solutions): I'll link quant test results and sample perf graphs in the checklist. Need vendor to confirm microcode 3.2.1 is minimum — I'll ping them.

sophia.mkt (marketing): I'll set up a shared GDrive folder for assets and a PR template for partner quotes. Will also prepare a fallback messaging plan if embargo slips.

anya.p (partnerships): Great. I'll post this summary to the vendor thread and request official dates. Please make comments directly on the PRs. :raised_hands:
